sources.snippet: We are releasing MiniCPM5-2B, the second model in the MiniCPM5 series, following MiniCPM5-1B. It is a dense 2B Transformer that scales up the same training recipe, built for on-device, local deployment, and resource-constrained scenarios, reaching 2B-class open-source SOTA.

sources.snippet: Download MiniCPM5-2B for free. SOTA on-device LLMs, small yet powerful. MiniCPM5-2B is a family of compact language models developed for local, on-device, and resource-constrained AI workloads. The current MiniCPM5 series includes dense 1B and 2B models designed to deliver strong capability with a small deployment footprint.

sources.title: Architecture graph for nassimjp/MiniCPM5-2B-SFT-Pashto.
sources.snippet: nassimjp/MiniCPM5-2B-SFT-Pashto architecture at a glance nassimjp/MiniCPM5-2B-SFT-Pashto is a text-generation model (llama architecture). It uses 42 transformer layers, a hidden size of 2,048, and 16 query heads with 2 key/value heads (grouped-query attention). The feed-forward layers use an intermediate size of 6,144.
